query: INSERT INTO staff_schedules (org_id, employee_id, work_shift_id, day_of_week, effective_from, branch_id) SELECT $1, $2, w.id, $4, $5, CASE WHEN w.branch_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM employee_branches eb WHERE eb.employee_id = $2 AND eb.branch_id = $6) THEN $6 END FROM work_shifts w WHERE w.id = $3 AND w.org_id = $1
